# UIGraphicsComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Draws boxes, gradients, outlines and textures in a script UI.

## Methods

### box {#box}

::: member

Fills the component with a color.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `alpha` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque) |

**Returns** [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) — this component

:::

### box {#box-2}

::: member

Fills the component with an opaque color.

```js
ui.graphics().box(0x202020).rwh(1, 1); // dark background over the whole screen
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) — this component

:::

### gradientH {#gradienth}

::: member

Fills the component with a horizontal gradient of opaque colors.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the left edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `color2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the right edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) — this component

:::

| --- | --- | --- |
| `color1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the left edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |

| `alpha` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque) |

Fills the component with a horizontal gradient that can also fade.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `color1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the left edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |

| `alpha1` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity at the left edge, 0 to 1 |
| `alpha2` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity at the right edge, 0 to 1 |

**Returns** [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) — this component

### gradientV {#gradientv-3}

::: member

Fills the component with a vertical gradient that can also fade.

```js
ui.graphics().gradientV(0x000000, 0x000000, 0, 0.8).rw(1).h(40); // shadow fading in downwards
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the top edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `color2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color at the bottom edge, as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `alpha1` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity at the top edge, 0 to 1 |
| `alpha2` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity at the bottom edge, 0 to 1 |

**Returns** [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) — this component

:::

### texture {#texture}

::: member

Fills the component with a tinted texture.

| --- | --- | --- |

### texture {#texture-3}

::: member

Fills the component with a tinted, translucent texture.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `textureId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | texture link, e.g. `minecraft:textures/block/stone.png`, see `scram.texture`. |

### outline {#outline}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `border` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | frame thickness in pixels |

:::
